name: Bishoujo Mangekyou -Katsute Shoujo Datta Kimi e-
original_name: 美少女万華鏡 -かつて少女だった君へ-
source:
In the middle of the mountains stands an isolated, rural hot springs inn.

There works the beautiful waitress, Inamori Haru.

Kamijou Souta, the lover of Haru, secretly pays a visit to the inn in order to surprise her...

This is the story of a night of passionate love woven by a foolish couple of adults who have fallen in love...

[Translated from the [url=http://omega-star.jp/bimanharuhtml/story.html]homepage's official synopsis[/url]]
translation:
山中，矗立着一座与世隔绝的乡村温泉旅馆。

美丽的女服务员稻盛春在那里工作。

春的恋人上条草太为了给她一个惊喜，偷偷造访了旅馆……

这是一对相爱的傻大人们编织的一夜热恋的故事……

[翻译自[url=http://omega-star.jp/bimanharuhtml/story.html]主页的官方概要[/url]]
